title: ReservationConfirmed
description: The data of the event reservation.ReservationConfirmed.v1: a reservation holds its room for its period. Reservation publishes it when a room is booked, and again when the reservation is rescheduled, with the new period and attendees. A consumer ignores the properties that it does not know.

roomId.description: The id of the reserved room, as the Facility API knows it.

startsAt.description: When the reservation starts. The period includes this instant.

endsAt.description: When the reservation ends. The period excludes this instant.

attendees.description: The number of people who attend, the organizer included.

organizerEmail.description: The email address of the person who organizes the meeting.
